sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "compliancecase"."transref" AS e, "transactionrecord"."ordertypedist" AS g, AVG("compliancecase"."prevviol") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("compliancecase"."modelconf" - "compliancecase"."risksc") AS REAL) / "compliancecase"."risksc")) AS m2 FROM "compliancecase" JOIN "transactionrecord" ON "transactionrecord"."transreg" = "compliancecase"."transref"  GROUP BY "compliancecase"."transref", "transactionrecord"."ordertypedist"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s1"."m2") AS m2 FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT AVG("s2"."m2") AS v FROM "s2") SELECT "s2"."g" AS g, "s2"."m1" AS m1, "s2"."m2" AS m2, ("s2"."m2" - "s3"."v") AS m3 FROM "s2" JOIN "s3" ON "s3"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s2"."m2" > "s3"."v"
quantities: compliancecase.relative difference of model confidence from compliance risk score
why: average of previous violations per transactionrecord within transactionrecord.ordertypedist
(model confidence - compliance risk score) / compliance risk score: the relative difference of two quantities in points
average of relative difference of model confidence from compliance risk score per transactionrecord within transactionrecord.ordertypedist
coarsen to g: AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged)
gap to the all average of average of average of relative difference of model confidence from compliance risk score (all level)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "transactionrecord"."ordertypedist" AS g, AVG(("sentimentandfundamentals"."infoleaksc" - "sentimentandfundamentals"."socscore")) AS m1, AVG((CAST(("sentimentandfundamentals"."inholdpct" - "sentimentandfundamentals"."shortintrt") AS REAL) / "sentimentandfundamentals"."shortintrt")) AS m2 FROM "sentimentandfundamentals" JOIN "transactionrecord" ON "transactionrecord"."transreg" = "sentimentandfundamentals"."transref" GROUP BY "transactionrecord"."ordertypedist"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m2" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m2" > "s2"."v") SELECT AVG("s3"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s3"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s3"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s3"
quantities: sentimentandfundamentals.information leakage suspicion score minus social sentiment score
sentimentandfundamentals.relative difference of insider ownership from short interest days to cover
why: information leakage suspicion score - social sentiment score: both in points and of the same kind (stocks) on the same sentiment/fundamentals snapshot
average of information leakage suspicion score minus social sentiment score per transactionrecord.ordertypedist
(insider ownership - short interest days to cover) / short interest days to cover: the relative difference of two quantities in percent
average of relative difference of insider ownership from short interest days to cover per transactionrecord.ordertypedist
gap to the all average of average of relative difference of insider ownership from short interest days to cover (all level)
coarsen to all: AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "transactionrecord"."trdref" AS e, AVG((CAST(("transactionrecord"."cancelpct" - "transactionrecord"."darkusage") AS REAL) / "transactionrecord"."darkusage")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "transactionrecord" GROUP BY "transactionrecord"."trdref"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v") SELECT AVG("s3"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s3"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s3"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s3"
quantities: transactionrecord.relative difference of order cancellation share from dark pool usage share
why: (order cancellation share - dark pool usage share) / dark pool usage share: the relative difference of two quantities in fraction
average of relative difference of order cancellation share from dark pool usage share per trader (by trdref)
gap to the all average of average of relative difference of order cancellation share from dark pool usage share (all level)
coarsen to all: AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "trader"."tradekind" AS g, AVG((CAST(("transactionrecord"."crossfreq" - "transactionrecord"."offmkt") AS REAL) / "transactionrecord"."offmkt")) AS m1 FROM "transactionrecord" JOIN "trader" ON "trader"."tradereg" = "transactionrecord"."trdref" GROUP BY "trader"."tradekind"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v") SELECT AVG("s3"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s3"."m2") AS m2 FROM "s3"
quantities: transactionrecord.relative difference of cross trade share from off-exchange trade share
why: (cross trade share - off-exchange trade share) / off-exchange trade share: the relative difference of two quantities in fraction
average of relative difference of cross trade share from off-exchange trade share per trader.tradekind
gap to the all average of average of relative difference of cross trade share from off-exchange trade share (all level)
coarsen to all: AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "transactionrecord"."ordertypedist" AS g, AVG((CAST(("transactionrecord"."darkusage" - "transactionrecord"."offmkt") AS REAL) / "transactionrecord"."offmkt")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "transactionrecord"  GROUP BY "transactionrecord"."ordertypedist"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v") SELECT AVG("s3"."m1") AS m1, SUM("s3"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s3"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s3"
quantities: transactionrecord.relative difference of dark pool usage share from off-exchange trade share
why: (dark pool usage share - off-exchange trade share) / off-exchange trade share: the relative difference of two quantities in fraction
average of relative difference of dark pool usage share from off-exchange trade share per transactionrecord.ordertypedist
gap to the all average of average of relative difference of dark pool usage share from off-exchange trade share (all level)
coarsen to all: AVG (averaged), SUM (additive), AVG (averaged)
